# Paper tables (generated by scripts/build_paper_tables.py)

All values are recomputed from per-sample predictions of the single frozen test pass (N=1,656; 828 patients) and cross-checked against each stored evaluation JSON. 95% CIs: patient-cluster bootstrap, B=1000. Sorted by test QWK. Single seeds unless the seed table (`SEED_ROBUSTNESS.md`) is cited; differences smaller than the seed-to-seed SD (~0.013 QWK) should not be called significant.
